step.action: Collect every returned impact driver and battery.
Inspect each battery for cracks, swelling, leaking, or unusual heat.
step.ifThen: IF damage or unusual heat is present, THEN do not charge that battery and tell the Dominatrix.

step.action: Insert each safe battery into its compatible charger.
Observe the charging indicator on each charger.
step.ifThen: IF the charging indicator does not appear, THEN reseat the battery once and tell the Dominatrix if it still does not charge.

step.action: Return every impact driver to its storage place.

passWhen.criterion: Every returned impact driver and battery is accounted for.
Every safe battery is fully charged or visibly charging.
No damaged or unusually hot battery is charging.
